_readme: Titles: honorifics and ranks a lady can hold (js/logic/titles.js). She can hold several (w.titles); the one she goes by (w.titleId, picked on her sheet) is shown with her name and gives its perk. Titles stay with her through New Game+.

label: how it reads. after: true = shown after her name ('Mira, Belle of Hollowmere'), otherwise in front ('Captain Rinna'). desc: the perk, in words (sheet tooltip and the 'earned a title' log line). fx: merged into the effect engine like a trait's (vocabulary: the _readme of traits.json).

How a title is gained: seed (only from data: characters.json / guests.json 'title', the label or the id), earn (checked weekly, then earnChance per week), event (granted by a random event in js/events/random.js, wording in events.json → title_<id>). A title can have several of these.
earn uses the traits.json earn conditions ({count, at}, {stat, at}, {trust}, {lewd}, {weeks}, {job, weeks}) plus {reborn: n} (carried over n times) and {all: [conditions]} (every one must hold).
Creator ladies: a free-text title that matches a label here becomes that title (with its perk); anything else is a custom title with no perk.

lady.label: Lady
lady.desc: Nobles pay 10% more, and her presence lifts the house's name (+5% reputation).

dame.label: Dame
dame.desc: +10 security and bad news stings her less.

professor.label: Professor
professor.desc: Passes on 20% more when teaching or coaching.

doctor.label: Doctor
doctor.desc: Recovers 6% more energy and settles into a better mood (+2 resting mood).

queen.label: Queen
queen.desc: +2 appeal and +8% reputation from her work.

leader.label: Leader
leader.desc: A Gym Leader's discipline: +6 security, passes on 10% more when teaching.

magistrate.label: Magistrate
magistrate.desc: Runs a house 10% better as madame; steadier moods.

madame.label: Madame
madame.desc: Runs a house 12% better as madame.

sister.label: Sister
sister.desc: Keeps the chapel 12% better, +2 resting mood.

hostess.label: Hostess
hostess.desc: Hosts 12% better and waiting clients like her.

radiant.label: the Radiant
radiant.desc: +3 appeal; outfits suit her better (+5 wardrobe).
